criteria.statement: A test shows each record is on disk in `calls.jsonl` before the next call starts (a fake client that throws on call N leaves N-1 records)
A test shows a provider error and a timeout become `error` records and the run continues
A test shows `--resume` skips completed keys and refuses when any identity field changed
A test shows `--retry-errors` re-attempts only error records
A test shows `--confirm-live-calls` without `--max-cost-usd` refuses in experiment mode
A test shows the run stops cleanly before a call whose estimate would pass the cap, with a summary naming the cap and spend
A test shows reasoning tokens are costed as output tokens
A test shows a model with no rate prints as unpriced in the dry run and a live capped run refuses to start
